text:
Maya (CS): Heads-up - AUREUS QBR is next Tuesday. Need a crisp slide pack: onboarding status, renewal risk, and token-econ scenarios. They reported unexpected embed-heavy usage during zephyr-alpha. Can we assemble numbers + immediate mitigations?
Riley (CSE): Copy. Which time window should I pull? last 14 days or 30? Also want to flag any sudden per-route spikes.
Priya (FinOps): 14d is good for short-term signal; 30d for commit planning. I'll run quick scenarios once I have the 7/14d averages.
Noah (Solutions): Customer PM said the spike correlates with a new "upload -> summarization" flow. Might be repeated retry loops causing duplicates. I'll ask them for logs.
spend-bot: NOTICE: account/aureus reached 60% of monthly commit (0.72M/1.2M) at 2023-12-18T09:02:07Z. Auto-sampling rule active.
Priya (FinOps): Quick baseline estimate:
```
Monthly commit: 1.2M tokens
7d usage: 510k tokens (7d avg/day ~73k)
14d usage: 890k tokens (14d avg/day ~63.5k)
14d extrapolated month: ~1.92M tokens
Gap vs commit: ~720k tokens (~60% over)
```
Priya (FinOps): Scenario notes: If upload->summarize is 2x heavier per call, and adoption goes from 10% to 40% of users, we land in 2.4M tokens/month.
Maya (CS): This is worrying for renewal talk. We should propose three mitigations in QBR: immediate per-route caps + sampling, mid-term Optimize tuning (batching + KV cache), and a commit re-opinion for next quarter.
Riley (CSE): I can add per-route rate limits and a temporary 10% sample on large uploads. Also will look into retry dedupe at the SDK layer. Small snippet I'd propose adding to runtime config:
```
routes:
  /v1/embeddings/upload_summary:
    max_rate_per_min: 120
    sample_rate: 0.1
```
Noah (Solutions): For the QBR I'd like to include a recommended Dedicated sizing delta and the cost delta for 3 commit tiers. Priya, can you produce that table with unit cost per 1k tokens?
Priya (FinOps): Yup. I'll include three columns (conservative/expected/accelerated) with commit suggestions and delta. Also adding option: temporary overage policy with soft-throttle + notification to avoid surprise bills.
Maya (CS): Also capture renewal risk language: if sustained >30% over commit, sales may see pushback on current commit; escalate to AE pre-QBR.
Noah (Solutions): I'll get a 30/60/90 plan: immediate toggles (24-72h), Optimize config + batching (7-21d), and model/quantization migration (30-90d).
Riley (CSE): Do we know the embed model? need to check whether open-embed-1024-legacy is in use or a newer cheaper vectorizer exists. That affects the migration timeline.
Maya (CS): PM reported legacy model in the pilot. Noah/Riley to confirm compatibility and potential quality delta.
Priya (FinOps): Timeline: I'll put a draft scenarios slide by EOD and a final packet tomorrow noon. Need usage logs from Riley for route-level breakdown.
Maya (CS): OK pinned actions: Riley - route breakdown and SDK retry check; Priya - 90-day spend scenarios + commit deltas; Noah - runbook + customer quote and Dedicated sizing; Maya - QBR narrative + renewal risk note. We'll review at 9:30am standup and lock slides by 2pm for internal dry-run. :white_check_mark:
Riley (CSE): On it, posting top 10 routes in a follow-up message.
Noah (Solutions): I'll reach out to PM for the customer-facing impact statement now.
Priya (FinOps): Dropping the preliminary numbers in the shared slide deck in 1hr.
Maya (CS): Thanks team. Let's aim to surface clear options (throttle vs commit bump) with cost tradeoffs so Sales has a recommendation during QBR.
